description: Move an application to another stage: applied, interview, offer or rejected. Inputs: id of the application (from add_application or list_applications), the new status, an optional interview_date as YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM, and an optional note that is added to the notes. When the status is interview, pass interview_date so list_upcoming can remind you. Example prompt: "Move application 1 to interview on 2026-11-20 at 14:30."

interview_date.description: Interview date as YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM.

note.description: A note to add to the application.
